notes.title: Innocent's Purgatory 1.5 launched
notes.content:
Hello Everyone.
A new big update has been released, the list of new features and changes is as follow:

-Added optional Quest markers, you can toggle quest markers to help you progress the story, by default the option is off, turn it on in the accessibility menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43017886/ebee152fb4612468b55d7de543b934149a414081.jpg[/img]
-Added a key rebinding menu, now you can customize the control to your liking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43017886/2a25f7c963631d10b1773070da749e7cc08b1aa5.jpg[/img]
-A new flying system has been added, now after obtaining certain item you'll be able to fly.
[previewyoutube=uOHgeAydBVg;full][/previewyoutube]
-Flying combat has been added, you can fight while flying.
[previewyoutube=jzHJlPb2Fr8;full][/previewyoutube]
-Added a new spell that let you summon an ally to help you in your struggles in the purgatory.
[previewyoutube=BThdcxqJNaM;full][/previewyoutube]
-Added levels to equipment and skills, level up will improve their parameters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43017886/8463ef14b299eb383e2bcf58edc55cab21e1a8e7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43017886/f1e299e97a1a79062035ab990020ea411a16d080.jpg[/img]
-Added a new weapon "Bloody Katana".
-Bosh Rush mode has been added.
[previewyoutube=31tq-zyNI0U;full][/previewyoutube]
-Added support for steam achievements, there are 17 achievements you can unlock.
-Changes to some 3d models.
-Bug fixes.

notes.title: Innocent's Purgatory is available now!
notes.content:
It's finally time to help Ethan to find out what they are doing in the purgatory and find a way to escape.

Can you find a way to escape and discover the secrets of this purgatory? Or will you find your end in it?

Innocent's Purgatory is a horror themed first person RPG, melee combat the evil spirits of the purgatory, use magic to gain an advantage over your opponents, explore the purgatory to discover its secrets, 20 hours of gameplay, 4 endings. 

I hope you enjoy the game as much as I enjoyed developing it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2169270/Innocents_purgatory/
